translations.app-description: Talk with your friends on your own private chat server, hosted on your machine. No more worries about data privacy or third-party services.

translations.perm.kick_members.hint: They can come back with an invite.

translations.server-settings.name: Name

translations.settings.title: Settings
translations.nick.title: Display name
translations.nick.hint: Any name, even one someone else has. Your handle always shows next to it.
translations.settings.handle-hint: How people find you. It belongs to this instance.

translations.link.wrong-code-a: The other device typed a wrong code
